{"category_edits":[{"category":"interaction_mechanism","rationale":"Learn a diagonal bilinear compatibility initialized to the existing dot product. Apply the same jointly trained weights during training and prediction across all four category models. The predictor writer already imports GRU4RecModel from train.py, so it automatically loads the updated architecture and checkpoint parameter. Preserve the GRU, history readout, loss, optimizer, and training settings.","edits":[{"find":"        self.item_emb = nn.Embedding(itemnum + 1, hidden_units, padding_idx=0)
        dropout = dropout_rate if num_layers > 1 else 0.0","replace":"        self.item_emb = nn.Embedding(itemnum + 1, hidden_units, padding_idx=0)
        self.interaction_diag = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(hidden_units))
        dropout = dropout_rate if num_layers > 1 else 0.0"},{"find":"        pos_scores = (out * self.item_emb(pos)).sum(dim=-1)
        neg_scores = (out * self.item_emb(neg)).sum(dim=-1)","replace":"        compatibility = out * self.interaction_diag
        pos_scores = (compatibility * self.item_emb(pos)).sum(dim=-1)
        neg_scores = (compatibility * self.item_emb(neg)).sum(dim=-1)"},{"find":"        return torch.matmul(cand_emb, user_emb)","replace":"        return torch.matmul(cand_emb, user_emb * self.interaction_diag)"}]}],"change_summary":"Introduce jointly learned diagonal bilinear scoring in each category's single GRU model, with matching training and inference behavior."}
